item.title: The Hindu: Twenty-four hours in Ahmedabad: A quick guide to India’s first UNESCO World Heritage City
item.description: A delayed flight and a failed alarm cost me a heritage walk. Undeterred, I set out to explore Ahmedabad’s contemporary art spaces, historic architecture and Sabarmati Ashram. How much can I cover in 24 hours?

item.title: The Hindu: Shillong Cherry Blossom Festival 2026: Nelly, Khalid, and Swae Lee headline two days of music
item.description: Shillong’s Cherry Blossom Festival returns November 20–21 at the Madan Kurkalang Sports Complex in Bhoirymbong, showcasing a cross-generational lineup that blends international stars like Nelly, Khalid, Swae Lee, Boys Like Girls, and Elliot James Reay with Indian singer Darshan Raval
